name: gtm-state-engine
description: Strategy-aware, evidence-backed GTM account-state and decision infrastructure.

scripts.api:format:check: uv run --cache-dir .cache/uv --project apps/api ruff format --check apps/api
scripts.api:lint: uv run --cache-dir .cache/uv --project apps/api ruff check apps/api
scripts.api:test: uv run --cache-dir .cache/uv --project apps/api pytest apps/api/tests -m "not integration"
scripts.api:test:integration: uv run --cache-dir .cache/uv --project apps/api pytest apps/api/tests -m integration
scripts.api:typecheck: uv run --cache-dir .cache/uv --project apps/api mypy apps/api/src apps/api/tests apps/api/scripts
scripts.contracts:generate: npm run contracts:openapi && npm --workspace @gtm-state/contracts run generate
scripts.db:current: uv run --cache-dir .cache/uv --project apps/api alembic -c apps/api/alembic.ini current
scripts.db:downgrade: uv run --cache-dir .cache/uv --project apps/api alembic -c apps/api/alembic.ini downgrade -1
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --cache-dir .cache/uv --project apps/api alembic -c apps/api/alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.format:check: npm run api:format:check && npm --workspace @gtm-state/web run format:check
scripts.lint: npm run api:lint && npm --workspace @gtm-state/web run lint
scripts.test: npm run api:test && npm --workspace @gtm-state/web run test
scripts.typecheck: npm run api:typecheck && npm --workspace @gtm-state/web run typecheck
